column2: By 1945 the Leibstandarte had been successfully moved east by train to Vienna, and the difficult task of rebuilding the division began.  The situation for Germany was critical - Budapest had fallen after a 51 day seige; Warsaw, Lodz and Krakow had fallen; a Soviet Army was in East Prussia; the Red Army was now a mere 200km from Prague, and worst of all, it had crossed the river Oder, and was only 70km from Berlin.  The I SS Panzer Corps was to be used to rectify this critical situation.
column3: 到 1945 年，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)已通过铁路成功东调至维也纳(Vienna)，重建该师的艰巨任务随之开始。德国的处境十分危急——布达佩斯(Budapest)在被围 51 天后陷落；华沙(Warsaw)、利茨曼施塔特(Lodz)与克拉科夫(Krakow)已经陷落；一支苏军集团军已进入东普鲁士(East Prussia)；红军距布拉格(Prague)仅 200 公里，而最糟的是，它已渡过奥得河(Oder)，距柏林(Berlin)只有 70 公里。党卫军第1装甲军(I SS Panzer Corps)将用来扭转这一危急局面。|到 1945 年，警卫旗队(Leibstandarte)已通过铁路成功东调至维也纳(Vienna)，重建该师的艰巨任务随之开始。德国的处境十分危急——布达佩斯(Budapest)在被围 51 天后陷落；华沙(Warsaw)、罗兹(Lodz)与克拉科夫(Krakow)已经陷落；一支苏军集团军已进入东普鲁士(East Prussia)；红军距布拉格(Prague)仅 200 公里，而最糟的是，它已渡过奥得河(Oder)，距柏林(Berlin)只有 70 公里。党卫军第1装甲军(I SS Panzer Corps)将用来扭转这一危急局面。

column2: Comrade General the Zitadelle offensive has exhausted itself! The time has come to attack towards Orel and threaten the German positions from behind! You should take command and coordinate the operations.
column3: 将军同志，「堡垒」(Zitadelle)攻势已耗尽自身！现在该向奥廖尔(Orel)进攻，从背后威胁德军阵地了！你应当接过指挥权并协调这次作战。|将军同志，「库尔斯克会战」(Zitadelle)已耗尽自身！现在该向奥廖尔(Orel)进攻，从背后威胁德军阵地了！你应当接过指挥权并协调这次作战。

column2: Comrade General you have failed to destroy the Italian Eighth Army! The Germans still threaten to release Sixth Army! Vassiliev is very disatisfied!
column3: 将军同志，你未能消灭意大利第8集团军！德国人仍威胁着为第6集团军解围！瓦西里耶夫极为不满！|普罗霍夫卡

column2: Comrade General, in reward of your bravery and devotion Comrade Stalin on Marshal Zhukov's proposal has charged you with the task of assaulting Berlin!!! For your courage you've been again awarded with the Hero of the Soviet Union. Hurrah!!!
column3: 二战 1/2：反击- 挡格|将军同志，为表彰你的勇敢与忠诚，斯大林同志根据朱可夫(Zhukov)元帅的建议，把突击柏林的任务交给了你！！！由于你的英勇，你再次被授予苏联英雄称号。乌拉！！！

column2: Comrade General: This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from Lithuania and open the road to Germany itself at East Prussia! You will command the First Baltic Front!
column3: 南乌克兰集团军群(Army Group Southern Ukraine) (#12) - 1944 年 8 月 7 日|将军同志：这是你把德国法西斯分子逐出立陶宛(Lithuania)、并在东普鲁士打开通往德国本土之路的机会！你将指挥波罗的海第1方面军(First Baltic Front)！

column2: Excellent! your actions were better than we had expected, you will receive much prestige to reclaim some transport to your units plus any upgrade you may do.
column3: 先头部队(Advanced Elements) - 1940 年 10 月 11 日|太好了！你的行动比我们预期的更好，你将获得大量威望，可为部队补充一些运输工具，还可进行任何你想要的升级。

column2: Good job Commander. You managed to hold the line and even send those Reds back a few miles.
column3: 干得好，指挥官。你设法守住了防线，甚至把那些赤色分子打退了几英里。|彼得库夫(Piotrkow) - 1939 年 9 月 7 日

column2: Great job Commander. Although Greece has fallen, those submarines have been destroyed along with a substantial portion of the garrison force in Greece.
column3: 干得漂亮，指挥官。虽然希腊已经陷落，但那些潜艇以及希腊驻军的一大部分都已被消灭。|行军命令

column2: Great job, Commander! The missiles are neutralized, and we push towards Moscow! Let's hope Stalin doesn't have any more secret weapons...
column3: 塞瓦斯托波尔(Sevastopol) (#5) - 1942 年 6 月 7 日|干得漂亮，指挥官！导弹已被摧毁，我们向莫斯科推进！希望斯大林没有更多秘密武器了……

column2: Great Job, Moscow is now back to normal and Comrade Stalin is safe thanks to your intervention.
column3: 干得漂亮，莫斯科(Moscow)现已恢复正常，多亏你的出手，斯大林同志安然无恙。|库尔斯克 (#16v)

column2: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise.  Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North. I am sure that you will do very well.
column3: 将军阁下，基什尼奥夫已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。我相信你定会表现优异。|将军阁下，基希讷乌已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。我相信你定会表现优异。

column2: Herr General, Kishinev is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North.
column3: 将军阁下，基什尼奥夫已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。|将军阁下，基希讷乌已确保。德罗部队正在占领乌克兰。这场胜利值得大力褒奖。不久你将需前往北方集团军群。

column2: Herr General, Ternopil' is secure. German and Romanian troops are occupying the Ukraine.  This victory is worthy of great praise. Soon, you will be needed at Army Group North.
column3: 将军阁下，塔尔诺波尔(Ternopil')已确保无虞。德军与罗马尼亚军队正在占领乌克兰。这一胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，北方集团军群(Army Group North)就需要你。|将军阁下，捷尔诺波尔(Ternopil')已确保无虞。德军与罗马尼亚军队正在占领乌克兰。这一胜利值得大加赞扬。很快，北方集团军群(Army Group North)就需要你。

column2: Kongratulieren!, now the Suez Kanal is under German control!, this will be a useful help also for our Japanese friends.
column3: 克林(Klin) (ZS#00)，1941 年 12 月 6 日|恭喜！苏伊士运河(Suez Kanal)现在已在德国控制之下！这对我们的日本朋友也会是有用的帮助。

column2: Outstanding work, General.  You have displayed superior tactics and abilities.  I will recommend a promotion to your superiors.  Keep up the good work and advance to the battlefield at Spanish Pass.
column3: 二战1/2：向柏林前进|干得漂亮，将军。你展现了高超的战术与才能。我会向你的上级建议晋升。继续努力，开赴西班牙山口(Spanish Pass)战场。

column2: Strock: Herr General or better ex-Herr General war it is a tough business.You should try another occupation.
column3: 施特罗克：将军阁下——或者该说，前将军阁下——战争可是门苦差事。你该换个行当试试。|沃洛科拉姆斯克

column2: Strock: Herr General, we have a pressing situation with Poland. For months now, the Führer has been trying to negotiate with them a generous settlement regarding Katowitz and Danzig. Since they have numerous allies on their side, including England, they have been very unreasonable and unrelenting in their demands. Several days ago, they have gotten so arrogant that they crossed our border at several places. The Führer felt obligated that in order to preserve the freedom of our citizens, we have to strike back. I want you to go forth with such force that they, and any future aggressors, will see that we will not be pushed into submission.
